verdict.rationale: A probe confirms nethunt.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200, but its content uses robots.txt-style 'User-agent/Allow' directives rather than an agent-oriented markdown index. An OpenAPI JSON spec is also reachable, which an agent could parse, while the docs.md endpoint returns 404. missing for 10: a properly structured llms.txt with curated doc links, markdown or agent-oriented documentation pages, first-party docs describing agent consumption, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
